end_to_end.note: Templated questions built from real (drug, PT) pairs; tests parsing+retrieval, not clinical truth. Brand aliases are learnt from the same FAERS data, so that row is a consistency check.

generator.reason: No generative model weights were available when this evaluation was run; only the verifier is unit-tested. Generated summaries, if enabled, are unevaluated.

caveats: The FAQ benchmark has 52 questions; confidence intervals are wide.
CTCAE definitions are formal NCI text, not patient language; they are a conservative proxy for linking.
Templated end-to-end questions use exact or lower-cased vocabulary terms; real questions are messier.
No metric here measures clinical correctness; the statistics themselves are validated separately.
